paper_title: Dependency Parsing is More Parameter-Efficient with Normalization
caption: Effective rank (W) reduces over training epochs as we increase N of BiLSTM layers.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The provided line chart illustrates how the effective rank (W) of BiLSTM layers changes over training epochs for ten different values of N (number of layers), ranging from 1 to 10. The horizontal axis represents training epochs, marked at intervals of 200, spanning from 0 to 1000. The vertical axis represents the effective rank (W), scaled linearly, with values ranging from 40 to 50, and labeled in integer increments. Each line corresponds to a specific value of N, as indicated in the legend on the right.

The blue line (N=1) starts at approximately 52.5 at epoch 0, drops sharply to around 50.2 by epoch 20, and remains nearly constant at 50.2 through epoch 1000.

The orange line (N=2) begins at approximately 51.5 at epoch 0, decreases to about 48.7 by epoch 20, then stabilizes around 48.7 through epoch 1000.

The green line (N=3) starts at approximately 51.2 at epoch 0, declines to about 47.8 by epoch 20, and remains roughly constant at 47.8 through epoch 1000.

The red line (N=4) begins at approximately 50.8 at epoch 0, falls to about 47.2 by epoch 20, then stabilizes around 47.2 through epoch 1000.

The purple line (N=5) starts at approximately 50.5 at epoch 0, decreases to about 46.8 by epoch 20, then stabilizes around 46.8 through epoch 1000.

The brown line (N=6) begins at approximately 50.3 at epoch 0, drops to about 46.4 by epoch 20, and remains roughly constant at 46.4 through epoch 1000.

The magenta line (N=7) starts at approximately 50.2 at epoch 0, decreases to about 46.3 by epoch 20, then stabilizes around 46.3 through epoch 1000.

The gray line (N=8) begins at approximately 50.1 at epoch 0, drops to about 46.2 by epoch 20, and remains roughly constant at 46.2 through epoch 1000.

The yellow line (N=9) starts at approximately 50.0 at epoch 0, decreases to about 46.0 by epoch 20, then stabilizes around 46.0 through epoch 1000.

The cyan line (N=10) begins at approximately 51.0 at epoch 0, drops sharply to about 40.2 by epoch 20, and remains nearly constant at 40.2 through epoch 1000.

All lines exhibit a sharp initial decline in effective rank (W) over the first 20 epochs, followed by stabilization at a lower value. The effective rank (W) decreases as N increases, with N=10 showing the lowest value (around 40.2) and N=1 showing the highest value (around 50.2). The rate of decline and the final stabilized value vary slightly between the lines, but all lines stabilize at a plateau after the initial drop.
